items.title: Dario Amodei's remarks at the AI Safety Summit
items.summary: Anthropic's CEO presents the Responsible Scaling Policy and its AI Safety Levels framework at the UK AI Safety Summit.
items.summaryZh: Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei在英国AI安全峰会上发表讲话，介绍了公司制定的责任缩放政策（RSP）及AI安全等级（ASL）框架，旨在应对人工智能快速发展带来的生物武器等潜在灾难性风险。

items.title: Introducing Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy
items.summary: Our Responsible Scaling Policy is a series of technical and organizational protocols to manage the risks of increasingly capable AI systems.
items.summaryZh: Anthropic发布其责任缩放政策（RSP），旨在管理日益强大的AI系统带来的灾难性风险。该政策引入了类似生物安全等级的AI安全等级（ASL）体系，对不同能力阈值的模型提出相应的安全、安全防护和运营标准。

aiReview.reasonZh: Anthropic发布的责任缩放政策确立了行业首个对高级模型设立分级安全管控的标准框架。

items.title: OpenAI Red Teaming Network
items.summary: We’re announcing an open call for the OpenAI Red Teaming Network and invite domain experts interested in improving the safety of OpenAI’s models to join our efforts.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布建立并公开招募红队网络（Red Teaming Network），邀请各领域专家加入，共同协助提升人工智能模型的安全评估与防护水平。原始信息显示：We’re announcing an open call for the OpenAI Red Teaming Network and invite domain experts interested in improving the safety of OpenAI’s models to join our efforts.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI Red Teaming Network”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI公开招募红队专家以提升大模型安全性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
